headline: Zelensky says Ukraine sank Russian corvette near Libya's coast and hit a cargo ship
summary: Ukraine's president said Ukrainian forces sank the Russian corvette Merkury, one of Russia's newest vessels, near the Libyan coast. He also said a cargo ship was hit.
why: Attacks on shipping in the Mediterranean raise war-risk insurance costs and can disrupt maritime trade routes.
original_headline: Zelenski asegura que Ucrania hundió corbeta rusa cerca de la costa de Libia y alcanzó un carguero
